notes: 0.3.48：修掉「仓库里有中文目录时，推送在提交前就挂掉」。现场是 sync.ps1 报 执行体调用异常：路径中具有非法字符，位置在索引预检的 Test-Path。根因：git 默认 core.quotepath=true，非 ASCII 路径被转义成 "workspace/DSH\347\240\264…"（带双引号），0.3.47 的预检直接读 `git diff --cached --name-only` 的输出，把带引号的字符串塞给 Test-Path -LiteralPath，Windows 认为含非法字符直接抛异常，整次同步（以及后面的提交、推送）全没了。修法：索引预检的 diff 与历史预检的 ls-tree 一律改走 Read-GitLines（内部 -c core.quotepath=false + cmd 字节重定向 + UTF-8 读），并给逐个 stat 包 try/catch，单个坏名字只跳过体积检查不拖垮整次同步。实测真实仓库 918 条暂存路径：含引号 0 条、stat 失败 0 条；历史预检 ls-tree -r -l 的 3222 行全部能按 tab 切出路径与体积。
notesEn: 0.3.48: fixes "a repo with non-ASCII directory names makes the push die before committing". The log showed 执行体调用异常：路径中具有非法字符 thrown from the index precheck's Test-Path. Root cause: git keeps core.quotepath=true by default, so non-ASCII paths arrive octal-escaped and wrapped in quotes ("workspace/DSH\347\240\264…"); the 0.3.47 precheck read `git diff --cached --name-only` output verbatim and handed those quoted strings to Test-Path -LiteralPath, which Windows rejects as illegal characters and throws — taking the whole sync (commit and push included) down with it. Fix: the precheck diff and the history ls-tree now both go through Read-GitLines (-c core.quotepath=false + cmd byte redirect + UTF-8 read), and every per-file stat sits in try/catch so one bad name only skips the size check. Measured on the real repo: 918 staged paths, 0 quoted, 0 stat failures; all 3222 ls-tree -r -l lines parsed into path and size.
